🫀 Grade 6 | Circulatory System Activity

Learning about the heart came alive as our Grade 6 students explored the circulatory system through a hands-on activity. They learned how to check pulse rates and blood pressure while discovering simple ways to keep their hearts healthy.

The activity was facilitated by Ms. Stella, our School Nurse, making science practical, engaging, and connected to everyday health.
